definitions.explanation: The nerve that carries sound information from the inner ear to the brain. Damage to it causes hearing loss that a hearing aid cannot fully correct.

examples.japanese: {聴神経|ちょうしんけい}に{異常|いじょう}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: An abnormality was found in the auditory nerve.

examples.japanese: {音|おと}は{聴神経|ちょうしんけい}を{通|とお}って{脳|のう}に{伝|つた}わる。
examples.english: Sound travels to the brain through the auditory nerve.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{音|おと}を{長時間|ちょうじかん}{聞|き}き{続|つづ}けると、{聴神経|ちょうしんけい}が{傷|きず}つくことがある。
examples.english: Listening to loud sounds for long periods can damage the auditory nerve.

examples.japanese: {検査|けんさ}の{結果|けっか}、{難聴|なんちょう}の{原因|げんいん}は{聴神経|ちょうしんけい}の{腫瘍|しゅよう}だと{分|わ}かった。
examples.english: The examination revealed that the cause of the hearing loss was a tumor on the auditory nerve.

notes:
{聴|ちょう} (hearing) plus {神経|しんけい} (nerve). Medical vocabulary, but common enough in health reporting and hospital explanations that learners meet it outside textbooks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聴神経|ちょうしんけい}が{傷|きず}つく: for the auditory nerve to be damaged
- {聴神経|ちょうしんけい}{腫瘍|しゅよう}: acoustic neuroma
- {聴神経|ちょうしんけい}の{働|はたら}き: the function of the auditory nerve

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {視神経|ししんけい}: optic nerve — the same construction for sight
- {鼓膜|こまく}: eardrum — the membrane that vibrates, not the nerve that carries the signal
